_README: Frozen measurement behind every shipped local-model label (#1950). TRACKED on purpose:
the judge receipts it was extracted from live under scripts/eval/runs/, which is gitignored,
so a test reading those directly would pass on this machine and silently test nothing in CI.
pass_rate_pct is (pass + minor) / total_scored from the receipt's overall block. s4_count is
critical_fail_count. Primary judge: claude-sonnet-5 over the twenty-case Type B behaviour
confirming_judge_pass_rate_pct is the SAME candidates re-graded by azure/gpt-5-6-luna the same
day, kept here so the labels' distance from their thresholds is visible rather than asserted.
It is not the source of any label. Note llama3.2: the primary run left 4 of its 20 outputs
unscored (an empty judge reply, not a property of the outputs), so its primary rate is over 16
cases and reads higher than the complete re-grade. Both land in the same band.
TO REGENERATE after a re-benchmark: extract these fields from the new run's summary.json files
and commit the diff. The diff IS the point. A moved score must be a visible change here and a
deliberate relabel in OllamaModelVerdicts.swift, never a quiet drift between the two.
